allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime, @{n='IsDir';e={$_.PSIsContainer}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Directory | ForEach-Object { $c = \(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File\); "$\($_.Name\): $\($c.Count\) files; ext: " + \(\($c | Group-Object Extension | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\)=$\($_.Count\)" }\) -join ', '\) })
